QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member #endif` and "`ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` compiles to `ctx->private_state` by default" with "Test and tool code that is not one of those translation units gets the mangled names"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows both macro branches and explains that code defining the opt-out sees plain names (library, programs, or any consumer who defines it) while ordinary consumers see the `private_` renamed ones.
